pokedexEntries.sw: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.

pokedexEntries.sh: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

pokedexEntries.sc: If it spots a berry tree, it will immediately go to gather berries without a sideways glance—even if it’s in the middle of a battle.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.
